$comment: Icon review batches and owner status (approved | revising | review). The gallery's Icons page lays tiles out by batch. Rotations and mirrors follow their base icon. Record: docs/specs/icons.md.

batches.title: Batch 1 · Core
batches.note: Approved by the owner on 2026-09-25. Back in review after round 3: open and reset (revised), bell (flare), and document, folder, copy and trash (corner radius 1.5; document fold enlarged to Fluent's size). Round 5 optical audit: person and warning enlarged.

batches.title: Batch 2 · Alignment
batches.note: Revised: centre variants sized to fill the keyline like align-left (bars 11 × 3 and 7 × 3, same height, radius and spacing); long bar first in reading order.

batches.title: Batch 3 · Docs chrome
batches.note: Round 5: slimmer flash, M-shaped book, sharper droplet tip and a larger bowl, three layers facing up. Candidates on the Exploration sheet.

batches.title: Batch 4 · Inspector
batches.note: Area's inspector marks redrawn on the system. Families derive: corner gives all four corners; flip, flow, gap and padding-sides transpose to their vertical forms; sliders is options transposed (listed with options). Rotate, flip, corner, flow and hide follow Figma's editor icons (round 1). Not yet redrawn: auto-position (its S-path cannot hold a standard arrowhead without near misses), bars-three (unused); eye and corner-radius duplicate existing icons.

batches.title: Batch 5 · Common
batches.note: Everyday icons, drawn on the system and sized by the optical audit. Pin shares the color droplet's construction with its tip down; clock uses the away-status hands; download and upload share one tray.
